definitions.explanation: Without any delay. A formal and emphatic way to say immediately, often used in demands, orders, or urgent situations.

examples.japanese: {即刻|そっこく}⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{行|い}け→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、{即刻|そっこく}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The problem was discovered and an immediate response was demanded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即刻|そっこく}⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The employee whose misconduct was revealed was fired on the spot.

notes:
{即刻|そっこく} means "immediately" with a strong sense of urgency and authority. More formal and forceful than ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ or ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

REGISTER:
Formal and authoritative. Commonly used in commands, demands, official orders, and news reports. Rarely used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即刻|そっこく}⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧: immediate dismissal
- {即刻|そっこく}⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧: immediate halt/cessation
- {即刻|そっこく}⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧: immediate evacuation/departure
- {即刻|そっこく}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: immediate response

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧/⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: right away (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧: immediately (formal, official)
- ⟦{即座|そくざ}→即座：11861_sokuza⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: instantly, on the spot

{即刻|そっこく} carries the strongest sense of urgency and is more confrontational than ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧.
